name: Bing News Search
tagline: Microsoft Bing News Search API for real-time news articles and headlines worldwide.
description: Microsoft Bing News Search API (Azure) returns news articles and headlines by query or category via REST with a subscription key—ranked results, trending topics, and category feeds with provider, date, and thumbnail metadata. Classic Bing Search APIs are retired/being retired on Azure; check Microsoft docs for current availability and migration paths before new integrations.

auth.details: Subscription key via Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key header; create a Bing Search resource in Azure portal.

pricing.free_tier_limits: F0 free tier: 1,000 transactions/month for Bing Search v7; paid SKUs (e.g. S1) have separate quotas and are not free.
pricing.paid_plans: Pay-as-you-go via Azure Cognitive Services Bing Search SKUs

rate_limits: Per SKU: F0 3 TPS; S1 250 TPS (and other paid SKUs as published). Transaction quotas also apply monthly.
use_cases: search recent news articles by keyword
fetch news by category (business, sports, technology)
monitor brand or topic mentions in news
build a news aggregator feed for a region
